results.title: Export MetaHumans from Unreal Engine with ARKit Blendshapes
results.author: Nick Fisher
results.text: If you need to export a MetaHuman from Unreal Engine to work with something like Blender, then head to fab.com and search for export MetaHuman as GLTF. That's one of my plugins. Download that and install into Unreal Engine. Open a project that already has some MetaHumans in the content library. They don't need to be in the scene. Click tools in the menu and export ARKit blend shapes. That's going to show you a pop-up dialogue with a list of all the MetaHumans in your content library. Select the one that you want to export. Choose the destination directory and then click export ARKit blend shapes. And after a couple of seconds, you're going to see a note that has been exported. So, you can switch to something like Blender, find the directory where you exported that mesh, import the GLTF file, and you'll see now that we've embedded all those blend shapes into the mesh itself. If you found this useful or any of my other plugins, please subscribe to the YouTube channel for future updates.
